## Summary

I implemented support for the language server to format (and diagnose) files located **outside** the configured workspace, by making the previously test-only `DynamicWithWorkspaces` mode a real, public feature.

### Source changes

**`crates/oxc_language_server/src/worker_manager.rs`**
- Removed `#[cfg(test)]` gating from the `ManagerMode::DynamicWithWorkspaces(Box<RwLock<WorkspaceWorker>>)` variant, `new_with_mode`, the dynamic-worker start/shutdown in `start_manager`/`stop_manager`, `read_dynamic_worker`, and the `get_worker_for_uri` fallback (routes URIs not covered by any workspace worker to the dynamic worker).
- Added `WorkerManager::new_dynamic_with_workspaces(builder, root_uri, diagnostic_mode)` convenience constructor.
- Added `# Errors`/`# Panics` doc sections now required since the type became public API.

**`crates/oxc_language_server/src/backend.rs`**
- `Backend::new` now takes `WorkerManager` as its third parameter instead of `Arc<dyn ToolBuilder>`, storing it directly.

**`crates/oxc_language_server/src/lib.rs`**
- Exported `WorkerManager`, `ManagerMode`, and `WorkspaceWorker` from the crate root.
- `run_server` now accepts a `WorkerManager`.

**`apps/oxlint` / `apps/oxfmt`**
- oxlint constructs `WorkerManager::new(...)` — unchanged `DynamicNoWorkspaces` behavior (its config resolution is root-based, so it must keep per-directory workers).
- oxfmt constructs `WorkerManager::new_dynamic_with_workspaces(...)` rooted at `file:///`, so files outside any workspace are formatted by the dynamic worker (oxfmt resolves config per-file, so this is correct).

### Verification

- File-watcher registration remains scoped to explicit workspace URIs only (the dynamic root is never registered as a global watcher).
- All 72 existing crate tests pass; clippy and builds are clean for `oxc_language_server`, `oxfmt`, and `oxlint`.
